groups.context_line: You will hear two students discussing their field research report with their tutor.
groups.instructions: Complete the sentences below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
groups.word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER

items.prompt: In the end the students gathered data at (1) ........ of the sites, fewer than the number named in their proposal.
items.evidence: We got round five of the sites.
items.explanation: The tutor points out that the proposal named six sites; the student says they could only get round five because the bridge was closed.

items.prompt: On the first visit the oxygen was measured with the (2) ........ .
items.evidence: for that whole visit we fell back on the chemical test kit
items.explanation: The oxygen meter would not calibrate on the first morning because the buffer solution was out of date, so the readings for that whole visit came from the test kit instead.

yeniden_uretim.eski_cerceve: On the first visit the oxygen had to be measured with a chemical (2) ........, as the meter could not be set up.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: cerceve_sozu: 'kimyasal bir (2) ile olculdu, cunku olcer kurulamadi' cercevesi hem 'kimyasal' sifatiyla hem de 'olcere alternatif' kaydiyla tek doldurmayi birakiyordu; konusma duyulmadan 3/3 turda yazildi.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Cerceve notrlestirildi: 'kimyasal' sifati ve olcerle kurulan karsitlik ('as the meter could not be set up') tumuyle cikarildi. Karsitlik artik yalniz seste: 'The meter wouldn't calibrate on the first morning... so for that whole visit we fell back on the chemical test kit'. Cevap, kanit ve turn_index degismedi.
yeniden_uretim.kaynak_prompt: denetim turu: dinleme alistirma yazim kusurlari (2026-08-18)

items.prompt: Contrary to what the pair had assumed, the highest score of all came from the shaded stretch behind the (3) ........ .
items.evidence: the best score came from the stretch behind the allotments
items.distractor_used: the top site in the woods
items.explanation: The students expected the cleanest water at the upper site in the woods; the best score actually came from the gravel-bedded stretch behind the allotments.

items.prompt: The finished report has to be handed in as one (4) ........, not as a separate document for each section.
items.explanation: When explaining how the report should be submitted, the tutor states that it must be sent in as one single file.

groups.context_line: You will hear two students discussing their completed work placements with their tutor.
groups.instructions: Complete the sentences below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

items.prompt: The length set for the reflective report this year is (5) ........ words.
items.evidence: The report is three thousand five hundred words this year.
items.explanation: The handbook the student has is from last year and gives four thousand; now that a presentation has been added, the limit has been cut to three thousand five hundred.

items.prompt: This year the log book is handed in as the (6) ........ .
items.evidence: this year it goes in as an appendix
items.explanation: The log book used to be handed in separately; this year it goes in as an appendix to the report.

yeniden_uretim.eski_cerceve: The log book is no longer given in on its own; it is now included as an (6) ........ .
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: esdizim_kilidi: bosluk 'as AN ...' kalibinin ucundaydi; belirsiz tanimlik 'an' cevabi unluyle baslayan bir sozcuge kilitliyor, 'tek basina teslim edilmiyor' karsitligiyla birlesince tek aday kaliyordu.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Tanimlik 'an'dan 'the'e cevrilerek unlu kilidi kaldirildi ve 'no longer given in on its own' karsitligi cerceveden atildi. Bosluk artik konusmanin kendi sectigi ada aciliyor; 'final section', 'last chapter' gibi adaylar da cerceveye oturuyor. Kabul edilen yazimlar yeni tanimliga gore guncellendi. Cevap, kanit ve turn_index degismedi.
yeniden_uretim.kaynak_prompt: denetim turu: dinleme alistirma yazim kusurlari (2026-08-18)

items.prompt: Both pieces of work must be sent through the (7) ........, because work sent by email produces no receipt.
items.evidence: they go through the module page, not by email
items.explanation: When the submission route is explained, it is said that email produces no receipt, so the work must be uploaded through the module page.

items.prompt: Students do not have to ask for the workplace reference, since the form reaches the supervisor from the (8) ........ .
items.evidence: Your supervisor gets the form directly from the department
items.explanation: Asked who will request the reference, the tutor answers that the form reaches the supervisor directly from the department.

items.prompt: The three paving surfaces were compared on one slope over a period of (9) ........ .
items.evidence: on the same slope, over eight weeks
items.explanation: Summing up the project in one sentence, the student says the measurements were taken on the same slope, over eight weeks.

items.prompt: For the body text of the poster the tutor sets a lower limit of (10) ........ point.
items.evidence: Nothing under thirty for the body
items.explanation: The student has set the body text at twenty-four point; the tutor finds this too small and wants nothing under thirty.

items.prompt: The square code that links to the data file should be put at (12) ........ on the poster.

items.explanation: Asked where the QR code should go on the poster, the tutor wants it placed at eye height rather than down in a corner, and tested on a phone before printing.

yeniden_uretim.eski_cerceve: The square code that links to the data file should be placed at (12) ........ rather than in a corner.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: cerceve_sozu: 'kosede degil (12) konmali' cercevesindeki karsitlik, kosenin karsisina konabilecek tek yer bildirimini birakiyordu.
